_comment: Phase 6 guards. Each one refuses before a job exists, or picks the right board. A first install with no bootloader refuses an image built for an offset, before a job and again at the write.

mutations.name: the bus is snapshotted BEFORE the write
the install family's artifact must exist
ambiguous DFU is refused when no serial is named
a named serial must actually be in DFU
mutations.find: if not any(d.get("serial") == target for d in scan["devices"]):

mutations.name: a not-ready BOOTSEL scan is refused
baseline is the whole bus, not untracked-only
mutations.replace:
_k = set(reg.all_serials())
        before = _k | {d.serial for d in scan_bus(self.paths) if d.serial not in _k}
